prior.source: engine/backtest/fit_prior_sigma.py — prior-only residuals pooled over 2018, 2020, 2022 at every horizon
prior.chamber_ratios_note: house 1.0 by construction. SENATE IS ASSERTED AND NOW TESTED (engine/backtest/senate_prior.py): measured at 1.400 on 99 Senate races against 1201 House districts over 2018, 2020, 2022, clustered se 0.416. The asserted value is kept because the measurement does not disagree with it — three cycles of Senate maps cannot separate the two — not because it was never checked. Re-run the module when a fourth cycle exists. GOVERNOR IS STILL ASSERTED AND UNTESTED: MEDSL's governor file is behind a Dataverse guestbook, and governors are cut from the model.

movement.note: Each cause is an exact re-run, not a linearisation. The range is the two orderings: these effects are not additive, and where the range is wide the causes cannot be separated.
